note: What is added over a base results directory to produce the results directory the generated pages are checked against (scripts/assemble-results-set.ts --root <label>=<dir>; no local path is recorded here). `entries`: ceremony run records, each source folder (a folder holding scenario-result.json, or with `each` a folder of such folders) copied to ceremonies/<row>/<as>/ of the output; only scenario-result.json is copied. `runs`: whole run folders copied to runs/<name>/. `files`: single files that replace the base's (run index, run READMEs). `sources`: what each root label is. Documented in CONTRIBUTING.md and docs/decisions/README.md (Final integration 5).

sources.about: This repository (results/overlay-files/: the merged run index kept as a text file).

Results set of the live VTI container rows (branch conformance/vti-live-rows, docs/35): ceremonies live.{onb,aut,kvc}.{ref,up}, live.avl.up and the run folder 2026-11-20-vti-live-core, built on the final4 set; its adjusted run README, run index and runs-before-run-json.json are taken from it.

Wire rows (docs/36): keyring-wallet to a live VTA over a real DIDComm v2 wire, record wire.up (2026-11-20), and the later passes wire3/kvc (FC-KVC, row wire.kvc) and wire4/mbr-idv-final (FC-MBR and FC-IDV in one run, row wire.mbr). The earlier folders of wire3 and wire4 (superseded, partial re-runs, rate-limited first pass) are not included.

The wire3/kvc and wire4/mbr-idv-final records of the wire root with the outcomes of scenarios the row cannot play re-mapped from failed to skipped (class D, D528) by src/ceremony/reclassify.ts; each scenario-result.json lists what was re-mapped (`reclassified`). Nothing else differs from the originals.

One run folder per row for the trust-task-discovery 0.1 gap vectors added in integration 5 (D524), run 2026-11-21 on the oracle and the VTI hosts: the discovery gap vectors (12 in all, the six new among them), one row at a time; main run, advisory results and matrix of each row in one folder.
Persona (FC-PER), directory (FC-DIR) and elections reads (FC-VOT) ceremony runs (2026-11-19, branch conformance/ceremony-persona-rooms-elections): rows per.*, dir.*, vote.*.
Gating run set after the B1 promotion (promote-b1 runs, gating-set/): cov, gap and 2l directories at the registry channel for seven rows, copied as run folders.
Gating run set after the B2 and B2b promotions (promote-b2 runs, gating-set/): the same seven rows.
Wallet emit re-runs (D304): original keyring-wallet 969963df, shim carrier, emit and emit-more.

VTI to keyring-wallet gap rows (branches conformance/vti-kw-gaps and conformance/vti-kw-wallet-legs, 2026-11-21): one folder per row, each holding scenario-result.json; rows named <group>.up.vti-up (original wallet and original VTI pin host). Decisions D530 to D613.

VTI to keyring-wallet gap rows, round 2 (branch conformance/gaps-round2, 2026-11-22, decisions D730 to D735): ceremony run folders per.*, perdev.*, onb.msg.up.vti-up, aut.s.up.vti-up, aut.refk.vti-up. The two probe folders (noruns.probe, vrc.probe) are diagnostics and not part of the set.

Baseline-fixes re-runs (branch conformance/baseline-fixes, 2026-11-22, D850 to D853): the original pin host with the original wallet after the acl/list step-down fix, rows rms-agent.up.vti-up, dev.up.vti-up and per.up.vti-up; they replace the earlier records of the same rows from the gaps and gaps2 roots, which failed at the harness setup.
